sources.articleTitle: GTA VI : les ventes du jeu à sa sortie ont atteint la somme record de 3,79 milliards de dollars

headline: GTA VI Reaches Record-Breaking Global Sales On Launch Day
metaDescription: Rockstar Games reports that GTA VI achieved nearly $4 billion in revenue on its first day of release, following over 32 million pre-orders globally.
aiSummaryBullets: Rockstar Games reported nearly $4 billion in sales within the first day of the title's launch.
The release saw 32.5 million pre-orders recorded prior to the official debut.
Early critical reception for the new video game has been largely positive.
aiContextParagraph: Rockstar Games announced on November 20, 2026, that the latest entry in the long-running video game franchise, GTA VI, has set a new financial milestone for the industry. The title generated approximately 3.79 billion dollars in revenue on its first day, surpassing the earnings performance of the previous game in the series. This commercial success was supported by a strong volume of 32.5 million pre-orders processed before the launch date. In addition to these sales figures, the game has received favorable ratings from professional critics, contributing to what is being characterized as a significant historical launch for the developer. The release marks a major event in the entertainment sector, with immediate consumer interest reflected in substantial search activity globally. The figures represent verified data provided by the publisher following the initial distribution of the game across international markets.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant public search interest and the record-breaking scale of the game's commercial performance.
